# Bagan Museum V1.6 — Offline Heritage 3D (10 Concept Models)

10 **original, independent** model studies are generated and bundled as GLB 2.0: Thatbyinnyu, Myazedi, Bagan Entrance Gateway, Tharabar, Gawdawpalin, Ananda, Htilominlo, Alodawpyae, Shwezigon, and Bupaya.

**IMPORTANT SOURCE DISCLOSURE:** These are not exports from the `.blend` projects stored in the supplied private Google Drive folder. They are *new stylized concept model meshes* generated by `tools/build_heritage_models_v16.py` based only on the source folder names and categories. They do not represent scanned/surveyed structures, accurate proportions, or true texture materials.

There is no Blender program installed in the current development container. The Drive source files are kept in place and their metadata/source links remain in `bagan_drive_catalog_v15.json`, not copied into this repo.

To replace the concept models with authentic user-supplied Blender exports, open a source project in Blender and use File > Export > glTF 2.0 > GLB with applied modifiers, optimized textures and scene scale, replacing assets/models/<slug>.glb and the embedded offline HTML viewer at build time. For now the builder regenerates concept GLBs automatically when Actions compiles.

## App Features
- Native Android, Bagan museum UI, guided tours, artifacts and V1.5 Drive metadata collection
- 10 offline rotating GLB 3D models through one embedded self-contained WebGL viewer
- Searchable Drive asset library, QR code links, quizzes, original museum GLB and ARCore concept view
- No live synchronization, no private Drive content published, no production release signing

## Build
GitHub Actions workflow `build-museum-v16.yml` on branch `bagan-museum-native-v1-6`. Artifacts include installable debug APK and all 10 GLBs. Android actual-device QA remains pending.
